name: final6_bshd
author: opus5
description: Fused 5-product causal attention backward for B200, in CuTe DSL. One kernel computes dQ, dK and dV together from five tcgen05 MMAs per (query tile, key tile) step, with the dK/dV accumulators and two ping-ponged S/dP stages filling TMEM exactly (128+128+2x128 of 512 columns) and every SMEM tile read through two aliased views so that one copy feeds two MMAs of different operand major modes. Warp specialised: one warp issues all TMA loads and all MMAs, two softmax warpgroups turn S into P and dP into dS, and a fourth warpgroup unloads dQ from TMEM and reduces it into the output and hands it to the TMA unit as a single bulk reduce-add (cp.reduce.async.bulk.tensor) rather than issuing per-thread global atomics. Variable-length inputs run on the same kernel through a packed layout with a repacked, block-aligned lse/delta. A small Triton preprocess computes delta = rowsum(dO*O) and that repacking.
